pairs.target: dìèrtiān zǎoshàng , tǎ wéi tízǎodào le dēngjìchù .
pairs.english: The next morning, Tavi arrived early at the registry.
pairs.hanzi: 第二天早上，塔维提早到了登记处。

pairs.target: mén hái méi kāi . tā yánzhe lángzǐ zǒu le yítàng , huílái shí , yǒurén zhèng bǎ zuówǎn xǐ guò de diànbù dā shàng chuāngtái .
pairs.english: The door was not open yet. He walked along the corridor and back; someone was spreading last night's washed cloths on the windowsill.
pairs.hanzi: 门还没开。他沿着廊子走了一趟，回来时，有人正把昨晚洗过的垫布搭上窗台。

pairs.target: nà rén wèn tā zhǎo shuí , tā shuō děng dáfù , shuōwán cái xiǎngqǐ duìfāng wèibì zhīdào shì nǎ yífèn .
pairs.english: The person asked whom he wanted. He said he was waiting for an answer, only then remembering they might not know which one.
pairs.hanzi: 那人问他找谁，他说等答复，说完才想起对方未必知道是哪一份。

pairs.target: " liùzhōu shìdú . " tā bǔ le yíjù . " lǐmiàn zuò , biétì wǒmen shǒumén . "
pairs.english: “The six-week trial,” he added. “Sit inside. No need to guard our door.”
pairs.hanzi:
“六周试读。”他补了一句。
“里面坐，别替我们守门。”

pairs.target: wūlǐ yǒu yìgǔ cháo zhǐ qì . tǎ wéi zuòzài dìyīcì láishí zuò guò de chángdèng shàng , jiǎo zhōngyú néng ānwěn fàng zhe , búbì bǎ xíngli jiá zài xī jiān .
pairs.english: The room smelled of damp paper. Tavi sat on the bench from his first visit, his feet finally settled without luggage between his knees.
pairs.hanzi: 屋里有一股潮纸气。塔维坐在第一次来时坐过的长凳上，脚终于能安稳放着，不必把行李夹在膝间。

pairs.target: tā děngdào wéi lǎoshī cóng yuànzi nà tóu guòlái , shǒulǐ ná zhe báobáo jǐzhāng zhǐ .
pairs.english: He waited until Instructor Vey came from across the courtyard carrying a few thin sheets.
pairs.hanzi: 他等到维老师从院子那头过来，手里拿着薄薄几张纸。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu xiān wèn tā zuówǎn shuì dé hǎobuhǎo . " shěn wán le . nǐ kěyǐ zhèngshì liúxià . "
pairs.english: She did not first ask whether he had slept well. “The review is finished. You can stay formally.”
pairs.hanzi:
她没有先问他昨晚睡得好不好。
“审完了。你可以正式留下。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tīngjiàn le , què méi mǎshàng zhàn qǐlái . chuāngwài yǒurén dǒukāi diànbù , shuǐzhū dǎ zài shí yán shàng , pīpā xiǎng le yíchuàn .
pairs.english: Tavi heard, but did not stand at once. Outside, someone shook out a cloth; drops pattered against the stone ledge.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维听见了，却没马上站起来。窗外有人抖开垫布，水珠打在石沿上，噼啪响了一串。

pairs.target: tā juéde zìjǐ gāi shuō diǎn shénme , zuǐlǐ què zhǐyǒu yíjù : " dōu kàn wán le ? "
pairs.english: He felt he ought to say something, but all that came out was, “You looked at everything?”
pairs.hanzi: 他觉得自己该说点什么，嘴里却只有一句：“都看完了？”

pairs.target: " tú , jìlù , gèmén kè de yìjiàn , dōu zài zhèlǐ . dúxiě yào jìxù bǔ , jīchǔkè zhào shàng , búshì jiào nǐ míngtiān jiù qù xiūqiáo . "
pairs.english: “The drawing, records and comments from every class are here. Keep working on reading and writing and attending basic classes. We are not sending you to repair bridges tomorrow.”
pairs.hanzi: “图、记录、各门课的意见，都在这里。读写要继续补，基础课照上，不是叫你明天就去修桥。”

pairs.target: tā bǎ zhǐ dìgěi dēngjì de rén , ràng tā xiān niàn jiélùn .
pairs.english: She gave the papers to the clerk to read the conclusion first.
pairs.hanzi: 她把纸递给登记的人，让他先念结论。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tīng zhe zìjǐ de míngzì , shǒu zài xī shàng mànmàn wòjǐn , yòu sōngkāi . tā xiǎng xiào , bù zhīdào duì zhe shuí xiào , biàn dītóu kàn zhǐ .
pairs.english: Hearing his name, Tavi slowly clenched his hands on his knees, then released them. He wanted to smile, but did not know at whom, so looked down at the paper.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维听着自己的名字，手在膝上慢慢握紧，又松开。他想笑，不知道对着谁笑，便低头看纸。

pairs.target: hòumiàn nà zhāng shì zhèngshì zīzhù de yuēdìng . xuéfèi , zhùchù , jīběn gōngjù hé dìngé fànshí dōu liè zhe , méiyǒu píngkōng duō chūlái de yídài gōngqián .
pairs.english: The next sheet was the full funding agreement. Tuition, lodging, basic tools and a fixed food allowance were listed, without a bag of wages appearing from nowhere.
pairs.hanzi: 后面那张是正式资助的约定。学费、住处、基本工具和定额饭食都列着，没有凭空多出来的一袋工钱。

pairs.target: bìyè yǐhòu , yào dào zīzhù fāng zhǐdìng de dìfāng zuò sānnián yǒu xīn gōngzuò , néng bunéng huí tóng jiē , zhǐ shàng méiyǒu dāying .
pairs.english: After graduation he owed three years of paid work wherever the sponsor assigned him. The paper did not promise he could return to Copperstep.
pairs.hanzi: 毕业以后，要到资助方指定的地方做三年有薪工作，能不能回铜阶，纸上没有答应。

pairs.target: zhèxiē tā tīng guò . zhècì tīng lái , què xiàng lùshang de chàkǒu zhōngyú dào le jiǎoxià .
pairs.english: He had heard all this. This time, it felt as though the fork in the road had finally reached his feet.
pairs.hanzi: 这些他听过。这次听来，却像路上的岔口终于到了脚下。

pairs.target: dēngjì de rén bǎ bǐ fàngzài tā miànqián . tā méi ná . " wǒ háiyào huíqù gēn sè lā suàn yícì . "
pairs.english: The clerk put a pen before him. He did not take it. “I need to go home and go over the figures with Sela again.”
pairs.hanzi:
登记的人把笔放在他面前。他没拿。
“我还要回去跟瑟拉算一次。”

pairs.target: duìfāng fān dào zuìhòu yíyè , wèn tā shìbushì bùxiǎng liúxià le . tǎ wéi de liǎn yíxià rè qǐlái .
pairs.english: The clerk turned to the last page and asked whether he no longer wanted to stay. Tavi's face grew hot.
pairs.hanzi: 对方翻到最后一页，问他是不是不想留下了。塔维的脸一下热起来。

pairs.target: " xiǎng . dàn zǒu yǐqián shuōhǎo le , liùzhōu yǐhòu de shì yào chóngxīn shāngliáng . wǒ bùnéng zhī xiěfēngxìn , shuō wǒ yǐjīng dìng le . "
pairs.english: “I do. But we agreed before I left to discuss things beyond six weeks again. I can't just write saying I have already decided.”
pairs.hanzi: “想。但走以前说好了，六周以后的事要重新商量。我不能只写封信，说我已经定了。”

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī lākāi pángbiān de dèngzǐ zuòxià , jiào dēngjì de rén bǎ dáfù rìqī xiě qīng .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey drew up a stool and sat beside him, asking the clerk to write the reply date clearly.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师拉开旁边的凳子坐下，叫登记的人把答复日期写清。

pairs.target: tāmen gěi tā liú dào dìsìshíqī tiān . nà yǐqián , tā kěyǐ zhàocháng zhù zhe , shàngkè ; ruò jiēshòu , zài qīnzì qiān .
pairs.english: They held his place until day forty-seven. Until then he could live and attend classes as usual; if he accepted, he would sign in person.
pairs.hanzi: 他们给他留到第四十七天。那以前，他可以照常住着、上课；若接受，再亲自签。

pairs.target: xiàshān liǎngyè de jiǎ jì zài lìng yìzhāng zhǐ shàng , huílái bǔ yìtáng cèliáng kè , búbì chóngxīn kǎo gāng guò de cāozuò .
pairs.english: Two nights' leave downhill went on another paper. He would make up one measurement class after returning, without repeating the practical he had passed.
pairs.hanzi: 下山两夜的假记在另一张纸上，回来补一堂测量课，不必重新考刚过的操作。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhè cái ná qǐbǐ , què zhǐshì bǎ rìqī chāo dào zìjǐ de zhǐ jiǎo . " háiyǒu tuìchū nà yìtiáo . " tā shuō .
pairs.english: Only then did Tavi pick up the pen, merely to copy the date onto his own paper's corner. “And the withdrawal clause,” he said.
pairs.hanzi:
塔维这才拿起笔，却只是把日期抄到自己的纸角。
“还有退出那一条。”他说。

pairs.target: dēngjì de rén jiāng zhǐ wǎng liàng chù yí . zhèngshì jiēshòu yǐhòu , ruò zìjǐ tuìxué , yào àn shíjì lǐng yòng tuìhuí shísù bǔzhù , shàngxiàn shì yì xuéqī ; xuéfèi hé gòngyòng gōngjù búsuàn jìnqù .
pairs.english: The clerk moved the paper into the light. After formally accepting, voluntary withdrawal required repayment of food and lodging actually received, capped at one term; tuition and shared tools were excluded.
pairs.hanzi: 登记的人将纸往亮处移。正式接受以后，若自己退学，要按实际领用退回食宿补助，上限是一学期；学费和共用工具不算进去。

pairs.target: quèyǒu kùnnán kěyǐ shēnqǐng jiǎnmiǎn , dàn búshì xiě shàng kùnnán jiù yídìng miǎn . shìdú zhè liùzhōu réng bù zhuī shōu .
pairs.english: Genuine hardship allowed an application for reduction or waiver, but declaring hardship did not guarantee it. The six trial weeks remained exempt.
pairs.hanzi: 确有困难可以申请减免，但不是写上困难就一定免。试读这六周仍不追收。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi ràng tā bǎ " bù yídìng " zài niàn yíbiàn , suíhòu zài nà xíng pángbiān huà le yígè xiǎodiǎn .
pairs.english: Tavi asked him to read “not guaranteed” once more, then dotted that line's margin.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维让他把“不一定”再念一遍，随后在那行旁边画了一个小点。

pairs.target: tā bùxiǎng huíqù zhī jìde hǎotīng de yíbàn , yě bùxiǎng bǎ zhěngzhāng zhǐ niàn dé xiàng yìfēng huàixiāoxī .
pairs.english: He did not want to go home remembering only the pleasing half, or read the whole sheet like bad news.
pairs.hanzi: 他不想回去只记得好听的一半，也不想把整张纸念得像一封坏消息。

pairs.target: líkāi dēngjìchù shí , tā bǎ zhǐzhuāng hǎo , zǒuguò chángdèng , yòu huítóu mōlemō bùdài kǒu .
pairs.english: Leaving the registry, he put the papers away, walked past the bench, then turned to feel the cloth bag's opening again.
pairs.hanzi: 离开登记处时，他把纸装好，走过长凳，又回头摸了摸布袋口。

pairs.target: mǐlā zài yuànzi lǐ děng sū yǐ , jiàn tā chūlái , gé zhe bàngè yuànzi wèn guò le méiyǒu . " néng liúxià . "
pairs.english: Mira was waiting for Suyi in the courtyard. Seeing him, she called across half the yard to ask if he had passed. “I can stay.”
pairs.hanzi:
米拉在院子里等苏苡，见他出来，隔着半个院子问过了没有。
“能留下。”

pairs.target: tā pǎoguòlái , pāi le yíxià tā de jiān , bǐ tā shuō chūkǒu shí hái gāoxìng . tǎ wéi wǎng pángbiān duǒ , xiào zhe ràng tā xiǎoshēng xiē .
pairs.english: She ran over and clapped his shoulder, even happier than he had sounded. Tavi dodged aside, laughing and asking her to be quieter.
pairs.hanzi: 她跑过来，拍了一下他的肩，比他说出口时还高兴。塔维往旁边躲，笑着让她小声些。

pairs.target: tā zìjǐ de zīzhù yě xù xiàlái le , tú shàng de píngyǔ yǒu sānháng , bǐ cāozuò shàng de cháng ; tā shuō děng kōngxiàlái , yào zhǎo lǎoshī wèn zhōngjiān nà xíng jiūjìng shì zài kuā háishì zài mà .
pairs.english: Her own funding had been renewed too. Her drawing had three lines of comments, more than the practical; she meant to ask the teacher whether the middle line was praise or criticism.
pairs.hanzi: 她自己的资助也续下来了，图上的评语有三行，比操作上的长；她说等空下来，要找老师问中间那行究竟是在夸还是在骂。

pairs.target: " wǒ míngtiān huíjiā . " tǎ wéi shuō . mǐlā de xiào tíng le yíxià . tā gǎnjǐn bǎ hòumiàn dehuà shuō quán , tā tīng wán biàn wèn yào buyào dài diǎn shénme .
pairs.english: “I'm going home tomorrow,” Tavi said. Mira's smile paused; he hurried to finish the explanation. Hearing it, she asked if he wanted to take anything.
pairs.hanzi:
“我明天回家。”塔维说。
米拉的笑停了一下。他赶紧把后面的话说全，她听完便问要不要带点什么。

pairs.target: tā yáotóu , xiǎng le yíhuìer , yòu shuō : " wǒ yào dài zìjǐ xiě de xìn . búshì jì , jiù náhuíqù . "
pairs.english: He shook his head, thought a while, then said, “I will take the letter I wrote. Not post it, just carry it home.”
pairs.hanzi: 他摇头，想了一会儿，又说：“我要带自己写的信。不是寄，就拿回去。”

pairs.target: " rén dōu huíqù le , hái dài xìn ? " " xiě le hǎojǐbiàn , bùxiǎng rēng . "
pairs.english: “You're going yourself and still taking a letter?” “I wrote it several times. Don't want to throw it away.”
pairs.hanzi:
“人都回去了，还带信？”
“写了好几遍，不想扔。”

pairs.target: mǐlā méiyǒu xiào tā . tā shuō zìjǐ de nà zhāng tú yě chāo hǎo le , zuótiān yǐ tuō lái lǐngliào de rén dàigěi fùqīn , shàngmiàn tóngzǔ rén de míngzì , yígè yě méi shěng .
pairs.english: Mira did not laugh at him. She said she had copied her drawing too, and sent it to her father yesterday with a person collecting supplies; every member of the group was named.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉没有笑他。她说自己的那张图也抄好了，昨天已托来领料的人带给父亲，上面同组人的名字，一个也没省。

alignment.english: every member of the group was named

pairs.target: wǔqián , tǎ wéi qù ménfáng wèn xiàshān de chē . míngzǎo sòng wán cài de chē yào kōng zhe xiàqù , chēzhǔ kěn zài huī ào huòzhàn tíng ;
pairs.english: Before noon, Tavi asked the gatekeeper about a downhill cart. Tomorrow's vegetable delivery cart would return empty; its owner would stop at Ash Hollow's freight station.
pairs.hanzi: 午前，塔维去门房问下山的车。明早送完菜的车要空着下去，车主肯在灰坳货站停；

pairs.target: dìsìshíliù tiān yìzǎo zài cóng nàlǐ zhuānghuò shànglái . tā wènqīng lù qián , cóng lìngcún de huíchéng qián lǐ shùchū zhèyìlái yìhuí , yúxià réng bāo hǎo .
pairs.english: It would load there again early on day forty-six for the uphill journey. He confirmed the fare and counted out both journeys from his reserved travel money, wrapping the remainder again.
pairs.hanzi: 第四十六天一早再从那里装货上来。他问清路钱，从另存的回程钱里数出这一来一回，余下仍包好。

pairs.target: zhè búshì tuìxué huíjiā . tā zài bùbāo shàng chóngxīn dǎjié shí , cái zhēnzhèng juéde liǎngjiànshì kěyǐ fēnkāi .
pairs.english: This was not leaving school to go home. As he retied the bundle, he truly felt the two things could be separate.
pairs.hanzi: 这不是退学回家。他在布包上重新打结时，才真正觉得两件事可以分开。

pairs.target: huí qǐnshì , pà wò zhèng bǎ qiú cóng chuángdǐ gōu chūlái , tīngshuō tā néng liúxià , xiān hǎn le yìshēng , jiēzhe biàn wèn tā hái rèn bu rènde yán chē pángbiān mài suāncài de rén .
pairs.english: Back in the dormitory, Pavo was hooking the ball out from under a bed. Hearing Tavi could stay, he cheered, then asked if he still knew the pickle seller beside the salt carts.
pairs.hanzi: 回寝室，帕沃正把球从床底勾出来，听说他能留下，先喊了一声，接着便问他还认不认得盐车旁边卖酸菜的人。

pairs.target: " nǐ shì xiǎng wǒ , háishì xiǎng suāncài ? " " nǐ dài huílái , wǒ jiù yìqǐ xiǎng . "
pairs.english: “Will you miss me or the pickles?” “Bring them back and I will miss you together.”
pairs.hanzi:
“你是想我，还是想酸菜？”
“你带回来，我就一起想。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi ná zhěntou rēng tā . zhěntou méi pèng zhe rén , pèngdiào le guà zài chuángtóu de wàzi . liǎnggè rén dūnxiàqù jiǎn , shuí yě méi xiānjiǎn zhěntou .
pairs.english: Tavi threw his pillow at him. It missed, knocking down a sock hung at the bedhead. They both crouched to pick things up; neither picked up the pillow first.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维拿枕头扔他。枕头没碰着人，碰掉了挂在床头的袜子。两个人蹲下去捡，谁也没先捡枕头。
